clips.send: Someone with five unfinished courses on their laptop sends this to their own group chat, anxious self-recognition, not inspiration.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says most people who fail at making money never actually fail at the plan - they fail at finishing it.

He breaks down the five ways people sabotage a course they already paid for: never start it, start it and never finish, finish it and never apply it, or apply it and quit at the first loss.

The course wasn't the problem. The follow-through was.

Comment BRAIN and I'll send you the free training Kevin built for exactly this stage, straight to your messages.

What's the furthest you ever got before you quit?
